text:
maya: heads-up  the nightly link checker flagged two items in the runtime examples: a 404 shortlink in the runbooks section and an outdated curl snippet in batching examples. low effort but needs an owner. can anyone grab? :wave:
ben: drop the failing urls?
maya: sure: `https://short.redwood/runbook/batching-guide` (404) and the example under runtime/batching.md shows `curl https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"batch":true}'` which no longer matches the SDK example.
sara: thanks for the scan, maya. i can handle the curl snippet update (swap to the new `--batch-size` flag and show streaming example).
ben: i'll take the runbook shortlink  we deprecated short.redwood last year, should point to `/kb/batching-guide`. i'll grep for other occurrences too.
docs-bot: link-scan: LS-2026-999 created  2 issues assigned to #docs, ticket DOCS-1402, severity=low
sara: here's a draft replacement snippet i'll put in the PR (sharing before opening):
```
curl -N https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize","batch_size":8, "stream":true}'
```
this matches the new runtime flags and shows streaming.
ben: nice. i'll update the shortlink to the canonical `/kb/batching-guide` and add a redirect from the old short.redwood path in infra. will note the redirect ticket in the PR.
maya: perfect. can you both request reviews from me? i'll sanity-check staging and our webhook coverage for short links.
sara: opening PR now: `fix/docs/batching-snippet-361234`  updates snippet and adds a small note about `--batch-size` caveat. cc @maya for review.
ben: PR: `infra/redirects/shortlink-batching-361234`  creates a redirect and updates sitemap; cc @maya.
docs-bot: CI: link-checker passed on preview; preview deployed to staging.
maya: verified on staging  link resolves and snippet renders. small nit: sara, can you add a one-line changelog note so product knows the example changed?
sara: done, added changelog entry "docs: batching example updated to streaming + batch_size" and linked CARD-215 in the PR.
ben: infra redirect merged and rolled out. leaving the shortlink alias in place for 30 days.
sara: merging docs PR after final lgtm from maya. thanks all  closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
